description: This file defines an abstract class 'Query' for building database queries within Drupal, including methods for managing database connections, query comments, and string conversion.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: Abstract base class for database query builders, implementing magic methods and query management functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Query object with a database connection and options.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares the object for serialization by excluding the connection property.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Re-establishes the database connection upon unserialization.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Resets the unique identifier when the object is cloned.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to run the query against the database.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Abstract method to convert the query object into a string representation.

methods.name: uniqueIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this query object.

methods.name: nextPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns the next placeholder index for parameter binding.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Adds a comment to the query for debugging or logging purposes.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns a reference to the comments array.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the database connection associated with this query.
